fields.Name: C1 -> C3.4
fields.Description: Gate G4.8 (owner PR 5, phase 4, dataset C1, criterion C3.4): a stopped sidecar ends the work it was doing Failed within the declared timeout (MLSidecar.DefaultRequestTimeoutMs, 300 s, when the protocol declares none), and the CLI exits non-zero on a failed result. The truth sidecar's Python process is killed (SIGKILL) and its wrapper restarted on the same URL after each half: (1) during the approved W1-signal build's training run -> the training run and the agent turn that ran the build are Failed within the timeout (the CLI cannot run an approved build: D5-A6-3); (2) during a `mj ai agents run` turn on the renewal request for the W1-signal world -> the turn is Failed within the timeout and the CLI exits non-zero (a run that reached no sidecar call is re-run, never counted, at most 3 attempts); (3) after a successful CLI run, the process ends within 10 s of its result with 0 established connections to the SQL port. Server transport (the agent runs as the D5-46 person); spends LLM money. Mutation: let a failed profile or build with the sidecar unreachable leave the turn running to its decline (drop the sidecar check) -> red. Run budget 60 min (MaxExecutionTimeMS).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The training run and its turn end Failed within 300 s of the kill; the CLI turn ends Failed within 300 s and the CLI exits non-zero; a successful CLI run exits within 10 s of its result with 0 SQL connections.
